description: This Kotlin source file contains a mock implementation of the RecipeRepository, providing in-memory sample data and methods to retrieve and manipulate recipe information for testing or development purposes.

classes.name: MockRecipeRepository
classes.description: A mock implementation of the RecipeRepository interface, providing in-memory data and functions to simulate recipe data retrieval, filtering, and state management.

methods.name: getAllRecipes
methods.description: Returns a flow emitting the list of all mock recipes.

methods.name: getRecipesByCuisine
methods.description: Returns a flow emitting recipes filtered by the specified cuisine type.

methods.name: getFavoriteRecipes
methods.description: Returns a flow emitting recipes marked as favorites.

methods.name: getRecipeById
methods.description: Retrieves a recipe by its unique ID.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of a recipe identified by its ID.

methods.name: getAvailableCuisines
methods.description: Provides a list of available cuisine types.

methods.name: createMockRecipes
methods.description: Generates a predefined list of mock recipes for demonstration purposes.
